title: POSTPONED: Rogers Pass Gun Verification Nov 4 -7, 2026
comment: Due to incoming weather not allowing proper gunsight verification, Parks Canada has postponed this week's shoot until early next week. Updates will be posted when dates for the verification shoot are confirmed.

title: Rogers Pass Gun Verification, Nov 4-7, 2026
comment: ⚠️Important notice for Rogers Pass backcountry users! From November 4-7, 2026, the East Rogers area will be CLOSED in order for Parks Canada and the Canadian Armed Forces to test the howitzers (similar to a cannon) used for avalanche control in Rogers Pass. Intermittent closures on the Trans-Canada Highway will be required while these operations are underway. Before you travel, check DriveBC for details: https://drivebc.ca Called a verification shoot, this drill ensures the 105 mm howitzers are firing accurately to protect the highway corridor from avalanches in winter. title: Mt Rogers South Face aka Halloween suffer fest.
comment: Needed to hike to the toe of the glacier as the approach is unskinable. HS of 20cm - 65cm on various point of Swiss Glacier. Crevasses and low points/depressions are visible and manageable. Low angle glacier skiing was great, approx 10-15cm of sugary facet snow. The steep Southern face of Rogers was sun affected and crusty. Crust broke off in chucks (approx 2cm thick) but did not propagate. We switched from skinning to boot packing 1/3 of the way up.
